summary.text: Christopher Markey is a Democratic member of the Massachusetts House of Representatives for the 9th Bristol District, which includes Dartmouth and part of New Bedford.
The Legislature's committee listing shows him on the Joint Committees on Election Laws, Health Care Financing, Housing, and Mental Health, Substance Use and Recovery.

paragraphs.text: The official biography page lists Markey's profession as attorney.
It lists his education as Bishop Stang High School, Stonehill College and the Southern New England School of Law.
